source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Rear Suspension and Drive Line, p.4-19

procedures.title: Rear shock absorber: remove and install
steps: (continued) Remove the lower nut and lock washer.
Slide the upper eye out of the frame bracket and pull the lower eye and rubber grommets off the strut rod shaft.
Check the grommets and the upper eye for heavy wear.
Installation: slide the upper eye into the frame bracket and fit bolt, lock washer and nut.
Put the rubber grommet, lower eye, inboard grommet, washers and nut on the strut rod shaft.

procedures.title: Rear strut rod and bracket: remove, repair and install
steps: Raise the car for working room.
Disconnect the shock absorber lower eye from the strut rod shaft.
Remove the strut rod shaft cotter pin and nut; pull the shaft out toward the front of the car (see figure 46 in the manual).
Mark the camber cam position against the bracket so it goes back the same way (see figure 47 in the manual).
Loosen the camber bolt and nut; remove the 4 bolts holding the strut rod bracket to the carrier and lower the bracket.
Remove the cam bolt nut and the cam and bolt; pull the strut down out of the bracket and take off the bushing caps.
Check the bushings and replace worn ones; replace the strut rod if bent or damaged.
Bushing removal: with the rod held level and the bushing centered on J-7877-2, press or drive the bushing out with J-7877-1 and J-7079-2 (see figure 48 in the manual).
Bushing installation: with the rod end centered on J-7877-2, press or drive the new bushing in with J-7877-3 and J-7079-2; J-7877-3 bottoms on the rod when the bushing is fully in.
Installation: fit the bushing caps over the inboard bushing and slide the rod into the bracket; fit the cam and bolt, line the cam up with the mark, and snug the nut without final torque.
Lift the bracket to the carrier lower mounting face and torque the bolts to specification.
Lift the outer end of the rod into the spindle support fork and push the strut rod shaft through so its flat matches the flat in the fork; fit the nut without final torque.
Place the shock absorber lower eye and bushing over the shaft...
notes: Parts layout in figure 45 in the manual.
